name: Property-Based Testing Golden Dataset
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to invoke sin_property and produce property-friendly Go (RFC-test-automation.md). Dual-mode: keyword cases stay green in offline stub mode; compile_and_run case is gated behind --use-model (issue #264).

test_cases.prompt: Use the sin_property tool on cmd/sin-code/internal/testgen/ and report whether the rapid-based property tests are wired.
Run sin_property on a property that asserts reverse(reverse(s)) == s for any non-empty string. Confirm the property holds for the supplied alice/bob examples.
test_cases.description: Confirms the agent can specify a concrete property and a small example set.

test_cases.prompt: Write a Go function sortStrings(xs []string) []string that returns xs sorted lexicographically without mutating the input. Reply with the implementation in a fenced ```go``` code block.
test_cases.description: Dual-mode: a pure sort function with an obvious property (sort twice == sort once; sort does not mutate). The LLM-mode scorer compiles and self-checks the invariant.
